summary_bullets: Extracted plan-voter effective-judge counting, degraded warning emission, and byte-order-sensitive status KV emission into scripts/lib-voter-coverage.sh with a sibling contract doc.
Raised the Voters 2-3 waterfall timeout to 1860s and documented per-round --design-tmpdir routing for dispatch and tally artifacts.
Moved tally-plan-review cleanup/status handling ahead of argv validation so non-zero exits emit TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS=tally-error without emitting VOTING_TALLY_FILE on early errors.

Extended dispatcher and tally harnesses for KV order, VOTER_PATHS_FILE omission/placement, status branch/degraded-warning coverage, timeout assertion, paired-PID ownership, and no duplicate tally status emits.
commit_message:
Extract plan-voter coverage helpers and harden tally status

Move plan-voter coverage accounting and interleaved status KV emission into lib-voter-coverage while preserving dispatcher stdout order. Raise the external waterfall voter timeout to 1860s and document per-round design tmpdir routing. Ensure tally-plan-review emits TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS=tally-error on every non-zero exit via an early EXIT trap, and extend the dispatcher/tally harnesses for the new contracts.
todos_left: Full make lint is blocked by an unrelated existing test-dispatch-panel-core breadcrumb assertion: the harness expects the '→ review: launching 6 reviewers...' breadcrumb in stdout, but dispatch-panel.sh did not emit it in this environment. Focused tests and relevant-checks passed.
